key.name: widgets
key.summary: The widgets and where they lie
key.description: A JSON list of {id, type, size, enabled, monitor, x, y, options}. Empty until the first start, which places a default set.

key.name: translucent
key.summary: Let the wallpaper show through the widgets

key.name: expressive
key.description: On: tiles in the tones of the colour scheme, and values on shapes that grow more pronounced with the value. Off: neutral tiles with colour only in rings and lines.

key.name: screens
key.description: own: each monitor has its own widgets. mirror: all widgets show on every monitor, at the same place on each. primary: all widgets show on the primary monitor only.

key.name: place
key.description: JSON of {name, region, latitude, longitude, timezone}, as chosen from the search.
